description: tiktok: Video Info. GET /v2/tiktok/video. Get a public TikTok video or slideshow by URL. Not-found does not prove deletion. Video files are in video.play_addr and video.bit_rate[].play_addr. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

download_media.description: Not supported: download_media=true returns 400. Use the play_addr or download_addr URLs in the response.

get_transcript.description: Set get_transcript=true for the video's native captions (WebVTT) at no extra cost. Missing captions return no transcript.

region.description: Accepted for compatibility. The US page is read.

trim.description: Set to true to get a trimmed response

name: tiktok_video
